name: Jack-in-the-Green

attributes.attribute: a masked young man in a leaf costume who danced in spring festivals descended from Beltane
a figure in British architecture that scholars connect with Jack-in-the-Green

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Jack-in-the-Green is a British folkloric figure. In some rural British communities, spring festivals descended from the Celtic spring feast of Beltane continued until recent times. In these festivals a masked young man dressed in a costume of leaves danced through the streets. Scholars connect him with Celtic tree-cults. They also connect him with the Green Man, a figure found in some British architectural contexts.

okr.objective: Document Jack-in-the-Green as a leaf-dressed festival figure linked to Beltane.
key_results: Record his appearance in British spring festivals.
Connect him with the Celtic feast of Beltane.
Note his link to the Green Man and tree-cults.
